title: ctenopteris aspleniifolia
intro: Ctenopteris aspleniifolia, commonly known as the maidenhair fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. The maidenhair fern is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Its therapeutic actions may help to reduce inflammation, soothe skin irritations, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Ctenopteris aspleniifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
